content:
tara: quick sync following the onboarding pipeline RFC. proposal: split heavy verification out of `verify-worker`. intake keeps fast admit (fingerprint + tiny smoke), verify-worker runs reproducible microbench + quality checks async. looking for objections and owners.

brad: fine with split. must keep a deterministic early-reject for corrupt/obvious fail cases. intake should return provisional status when smoke passes but verify not done.

mina: agree. we should define a minimal handshake payload the intake posts to verify queue: model_uri, fingerprint, admit_ts, provisional_id, golden_manifest_uri, trace_id, binary_profile(optional), priority.

tara: yes. also include a rate_limit_hint and expected_latency_ms so verify-worker can schedule.

brad: what about reproducibility? verify-worker must include sample_indexes + RNG_seed in results so we can rerun exact checks.

mina: storage/econ note: avoid copying weights at ingest. verify-worker should fetch by immutable URIs and use a shared cache keyed by fingerprint. infra: can you provision read-only short-lived signed URLs?

infra: yes, will provide signed URIs + service tokens. will also surface cache hit metrics.

tara: rollout plan: shadow verify for 14 days (no state changes). measure disagreement rate vs current admits; goal <0.5% before enforcement.

brad: policy for failures: if regression_score > 0.25 AND tail_latency > expected * 2 -> quarantine + auto-ticket; else flag QA. per-tenant override allowed.

mina: monitoring: regression_score timeseries, per-sample diffs, verify latency histogram, cache-miss ratio. UI: registry should show provisional badge with link to verify results and a "re-run verify" button.

audit-bot: note: verify-worker must sign results; include provenance: binary_profile, manifest_version, seed, runtime_hash.

tara: owners: I'll draft handshake spec; mina owns UI + triage flow; brad owns policy thresholds; infra owns tokens/cache. sync Fri 9:30 to review.

brad: ack.

mina: thanks all. :thumbsup:
